author: Melissa Gawne
text: Awesome service! Kept in contact with me. Also came out same day i called. Ended up having a completely frozen solid pipe and he investigated thoroughly to find the issue. Very welcome behavior.

author: Deedra Vorndran
text: Great communication and on time. Friendly and explained everything well. He opened my septic lid and dug up a 2nd lid I didn't even know about. He gave a great price. I have had several other companies out here and no one else open the lid to actually discover the actual issue. He replaced my baffle, installed a riser, and cleaned out my septic and leech field. Great job.

author: Jeff Hodge
text: Anthony and James(American Septic) are the best in the business. They do a great job and won't screw you for things you don't need. Super quick and thorough service.

author: bonnie martin
text: These Guys are totally professional and don’t mess around.They worked hard and know the line of work they are in.Personable and very good at what they do.I highly recommend American septic and will be using them for any future needs or concerns.I will rest better knowing they took care of my system.

author: Emma T.V
text: Absolutely fantastic! We’ve been having issues since August, they came out the day after we called them and fixed our problem completely! They also didn’t break the bank. They worked in the cold and snow and were super kind and professional. Would a million percent recommend
